verdict.rationale: cfo.ai records every Model change (formulas, Table blocks, Page edits) in a changelog under the user's name and makes it undoable. Numbers print lineage back to the source line, and users can open the Model to inspect and change assumptions. Scenarios are generated on request, but the docs never say each scenario keeps its own assumption record or that scenarios can be compared side by side. Missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption records, a documented scenario-comparison view tied to the audit trail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
